items.stem: Which sequence correctly describes the TCP three-way handshake?

options.rationale: Correct: the client sends SYN, the server replies SYN-ACK, and the client sends ACK.
This is not the handshake sequence; FIN is used to close a connection.
These flags relate to closing or resetting, not establishing, a connection.
These flags do not form the connection-establishment handshake.

items.explanation: Correct: the client sends SYN, the server replies SYN-ACK, and the client sends ACK.

items.stem: What is the main difference between signature-based and anomaly-based intrusion detection?

options.text: Signature-based matches known patterns; anomaly-based flags deviations from a baseline
options.rationale: Correct: signatures detect known bad patterns while anomaly detection flags unusual behaviour.

options.text: Signature-based requires no rules at all
options.rationale: Signature-based detection depends on defined signatures/rules.

options.text: Anomaly-based can only detect previously seen attacks
options.rationale: Anomaly detection targets deviations, including novel behaviour.

options.text: They are identical and interchangeable terms

items.explanation: Correct: signatures detect known bad patterns while anomaly detection flags unusual behaviour.

items.stem: Select TWO signs that network traffic may indicate a port scan.

options.text: Connection attempts to many different ports on one host in a short time
options.rationale: Correct: sweeping many ports quickly is a classic scan indicator.

options.text: Many SYN packets with few completed handshakes
options.rationale: Correct: SYN scans leave many half-open connections.

options.text: A single long-lived, fully established HTTPS session
options.rationale: A normal established session is not itself a scan indicator.

options.text: A DNS reply to a legitimate query
options.rationale: A normal DNS reply is expected traffic.

options.text: An NTP time-sync request on schedule
options.rationale: Scheduled time sync is normal, expected traffic.

items.explanation: Correct: sweeping many ports quickly is a classic scan indicator.
